longTitle.officialTitle: making appropriations for the Department of Agriculture for the fiscal year ending June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and eight.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.content: That the following sums be, and they are hereby, appropriated, out of any money in the Treasury of the United States not otherwise appropriated, in full compensation for the fiscal year ending June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and eight, for the purposes and objects hereinafter expressed, namely:

compsdtd:appropriations-para.compsdtd:text: Provided further, 1 That all money received after July first, nineteen hundred and seven, by or on account of the forest service for timber, or from any other source of forest reservation revenue, shall be covered into the Treasury of the United States as a miscellaneous receipt and there is hereby appropriated and made available as the Secretary of Agriculture may direct out of any funds in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, so much as may be necessary to make refunds to depositors of money heretofore or hereafter deposited by them to secure the purchase price on the sale of any products or for the use of any land or resources of the national forests in excess of amounts found actually due from them to the United States:

compsdtd:footnote.compsdtd:para: Cite as follows: The fifth paragraph under the heading FOREST SERVICE in the Act of March 4, 1907 (34 Stat. 1270).
